summary: Reviewed DEMO-PREVIEW from base 017914f to HEAD 9148c13 (clean worktree). The diff lowers the shared constant DISPLAY_LIMIT from 12 to 8 in src/formatting.py and adds tests/README.md. Base scope matches tasks/traceability: T-1 is the only task and R-1 lists only src/formatting.py as code. src/receipt.py was not changed, but it imports the same constant. Receipt references are now cut to 8 characters instead of 12, which breaks the confirmed rule that receipt formatting must stay unchanged. This is an implementation defect, not a product question. The next step is a technical fix: decouple the receipt limit so it stays at 12, add tests for preview length over 8 and for receipt behavior at base, then have the router run tests. No new product decision is needed and accepting the regression is not an authorized option. The only mapped test (short input) does not cover the new length limit or receipt behavior. Source S2 (sources/layout.png) is unavailable. Elapsed time and token usage were not measured.

findings.claim: Confirmed mismatch (implementation defect): changing the shared DISPLAY_LIMIT from 12 to 8 also cuts receipt references to 8 characters. This breaks R-1's confirmed rule to keep receipt formatting unchanged. Fixing it restores confirmed behavior with a technical change (for example, a separate receipt limit of 12, or a preview-only constant). It does not need a new product decision.
